about: wc-001 and wc-003 lab falsifiers. Each one plants a bug in the capsule source, the build script, the bundle tool or its closure rule (tools/lab_name.rs) and requires every named test to FAIL (error-free). wc-001: F-WC1 embeds an absolute build path so the two clean builds differ; F-WC1-SPACED-PATH splits the remap flags on a space in the build path; the rest change the digest result, retain an import, alter the digest signature, record a wrong toolchain/hash in the receipt, or name a compiler other than the one Cargo was told to use. wc-003: F-WC3a leaves the manifest out of the closure and F-WC3b hashes the mtime; the rest hash the mode or the arrival order, drop the module bytes or the path framing, bypass the closure rule in the command, label the name CID, skip an extra file, accept a missing closure file, drop a manifest field, let the one open follow a symlink or wait on a FIFO, skip the regular-file check on the opened handle, read the path again after that check, reuse an existing bundle path, or let tools/build write its outputs through a link. command is "lab" and file paths are relative to examples/agent-host/, so a lab file is ../../lab/wasm-capsule/... . The canonical runner falsify.py has no "lab" command yet (ask R1), so these are proved by the repo's break -> named test fails -> revert method with `cargo test` in the lab workspace until R1 lands.
